userQuote: I'm observing some non-curved angles here.
fixSummary: Device-space adaptive subdivision of contour fill rulings (refineFillRunTurns, surface-fill.js), deferred to run after the seam join so a join vertex is checked as an ordinary interior vertex; edgeAt now returns its own bisected sweep parameter instead of reusing its neighbour's.
bar: FILL_MAX_TURN_DEG = 8 (device-space per-vertex exterior turn, open-polyline-aware, closed-ring wrap-aware)

measurements.note: M1 = max per-vertex device-space exterior turn (deg), measured on the RAW drawn polyline via the RGR oracle in tests/unit/scene3d-fill-ruling-corners.test.js. Gallery cells (C1/C3) and the real app-default scene (C2) both measured.

appDefaultScene_postFillCurvesFit_report.note: The shipped Fill-Curves fitter (src/core/geometry-utils.js, out of this lane) can still read over 8deg on this fix's now-uneven point density. Measured this run: capsule 14.72, cone 28.07, cylinder 28.23, sphere 15.37 deg. See implementer report 'Known limitation'.

byteIdenticalPairsExplained: None expected in this cell set — every named cell is mapper==='contour', squarely in scope; the fix is expected to (and does) move every one of them. Byte-identity is instead verified via the guard suite on OUT-OF-SCOPE cells (sphere hatch, cylinder hatch, box/plane/pyramid/solid) — see the implementer report's guard list, all green.

look.capsule__contour__ladder__med__a: Crop (150,10)-(310,90) at 6x on the innermost cap ring: reads as a clean, smooth ellipse with no visible corner or facet at either end of its major axis (previously the sharpest defect on this rig, per the W-32/W-33 plan's own crop of the same region).

look.cone__contour__ladder__med__b: Crop (140,10)-(320,110) at 6x near the apex: the small rings stacked toward the tip read smooth.
look.cylinder__contour__ladder__med__a: Crop (140,10)-(320,100) at 6x near the top cap: the innermost cap ring and the two rings below it all read smooth.
